context: Tests whether the agent correctly identifies a .csproj file, maps it to the dotnet language parameter, extracts NuGet PackageReference versions, and produces a correctly formatted audit report.

checklist.name: dotnet language
checklist.description: Sets language to `dotnet` for NuGet packages (not `csharp`, `net`, `.net`, `nuget`, or `cs`)

checklist.name: csproj discovery
checklist.description: Discovers the .csproj file using a Glob pattern (e.g. *.csproj) rather than hardcoding the filename

checklist.name: PackageReference extraction
checklist.description: Extracts package names and versions from the PackageReference elements in the .csproj file

checklist.name: JSON array format
checklist.description: Constructs a JSON array of `{language, name, version}` objects and pipes it to `npx @meterian/cli check`

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with the required audit columns (Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Versions)

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with vulnerability and package counts
